description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. You will play a critical role in strategic planning, financial management, and quality improvement initiatives to drive the facility's success.

This role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 - $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. Join a dedicated team committed to providing exceptional rehabilitation services and making a meaningful difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex operations, financial performance, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Commitment to quality care and resident satisfaction.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation: $115,000 - $145,000 per year, based on experience.
